name: M7.Connectivity.one_mem_top
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (H : AddSubgroup (ZMod N)), (1 : ZMod N) ∈ H ↔ H = ⊤
context:
theorem M7.Connectivity.scalar_mem : ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (H : AddSubgroup (ZMod N)) (a r : ZMod N), a ∈ H → r*a ∈ H := by
  change ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (H : AddSubgroup (ZMod N)) (a r : ZMod N), a ∈ H → r * a ∈ H
  intro N inst H a r ha
  simpa only [nsmul_eq_mul, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] using H.nsmul_mem ha r.val
guidance: If H contains one, scalar_mem with scalar x puts every x in H. Reverse top membership. N=1 is retained. Use original exact statement. Return tactic lines without leading by.
